meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 在编辑代码后会自动检查新增或修改的注释，如果发现有问题会给出警告，并要求你修复或解释。
howto.when: 当你使用 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑工具成功修改代码后，comment-checker 会自动运行并检查注释。

say.text: 修复这个注释，它不符合规范。
say.note: Claude 会收到警告并尝试修正注释。

say.text: 解释一下为什么这个注释需要保留。
say.note: Claude 会说明注释的合理性。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically checks new or modified comments after editing code, and if issues are found, it warns you and asks you to fix or explain them.
howto.when_en: Triggered after successful edit-like tool calls such as apply_patch, write, edit, etc., when comment-checker reports a warning.

say_en.text: Fix this comment, it doesn't meet the standard.
say_en.note: Claude will receive a warning and attempt to correct the comment.

say_en.text: Explain why this comment needs to stay.
say_en.note: Claude will justify the comment's necessity.
